answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price, while the low-cost vendor alone meets Finance's 18% reduction mandate and the contract expires in 14 days. Verify the prior low-cost-vendor record before committing, with particular focus on whether prior quick onboarding and accurate invoicing translated to dependable delivery performance. The 94% line utilization means any primary-source transition carries material interruption risk, so constrain initial exposure with explicit delivery, inventory, and contingency controls rather than assuming historical cost performance proves supply reliability.
